chain.label: Bird ingested into left (No. 1) engine during initial climb
chain.trigger: a bird was ingested into the left (No. 1) engine, a CFM International LEAP-1B, during the initial climb

chain.label: No. 1 engine violent vibration with loss of thrust
chain.trigger: the airplane began to “shake violently with a distinct loss of thrust” in the No. 1 engine

caused_by.evidence: a “thump” on the left side of the airplane. The flight crew reported that the airplane began to “shake violently with a distinct loss of thrust” in the No. 1 engine

chain.label: Load reduction device (LRD) activated on fan imbalance, exposing an unintended path for oil into the bleed air system
chain.trigger: smoke entered the cockpit as a result of the activation of the LRD, an engine system design feature

caused_by.evidence: The LRD minimizes aircraft and engine damage during a fan blade failure or significant fan blade imbalance by reducing the severity of the vibration transmitted from the damaged engine to the airframe

chain.label: Oil tubes dislodged and sump flange opened, allowing oil into core compressor upstream of bleed ports
chain.trigger: tubes supplying oil to the engine sump to become dislodged and the flange from the sump area to open, which allowed oil to enter the core compressor upstream of the pneumatic bleed ports

caused_by.evidence: Activation of the LRD in the MSY event caused tubes supplying oil to the engine sump to become dislodged and the flange from the sump area to open

chain.label: Oil exposed to high engine temperatures produced smoke/fumes fed into the cockpit
chain.trigger: The oil was exposed to high temperatures and resulted in smoke and fumes that were then fed into the cockpit

caused_by.evidence: The oil was exposed to high temperatures and resulted in smoke and fumes that were then fed into the cockpit

chain.label: Crew declared emergency and landed safely at MSY with no injuries and minor aircraft damage
chain.trigger: The flight crew declared an emergency to air traffic control...After landing at MSY, the airplane came to a full stop on the arrival runway

caused_by.evidence: the flight deck filled with “acrid white smoke”; the FO later stated that he could not clearly see the captain
